thread:
Sam: Heads-up y'all — I accepted a promotion to Senior Engineering Manager 🎉 Moving to Seattle next month. Want to do a small send-off in the kitchen on Fri 4/26 around 12:30pm. Cake + coffee?
Priya: Yesss congrats Sam!! so proud :tada: can help coordinate
Devon: Huge congrats!! count me in for Fri
Maya: Congrats!! 12:30 works for me. Want me to grab plates/utensils?
Sam: That'd be awesome, Maya. I'll order cake (vegan option for Liam) and bring coffee ☕
HR Bot: Congrats @Sam! Please submit the manager transfer form: /hr-transfer. Also ping People Ops for relocation logistics — moving stipend and home-search help available.
Liam: Congrats Sam!! :clap: Vegan cake would be great, thanks for accommodating
Priya: Quick Q — do you want a short shoutout in next all-hands about the move/promotion?
Sam: Happy to do a 2-min shoutout if that helps folks know who to reach out to after I switch teams
Devon: Definitely would be good for context. Also, any chance we can record the all-hands segment? I might be traveling.
Maya: I'll put a calendar hold for the cake send-off and add a note to the team board.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Honestly couldn't have done it without the team's support — can I bribe you with brownies too? :yum:
Liam: Brownies accepted :ok_hand:
HR Bot: @Sam, I scheduled a 30-min check-in with People Ops next Tue to go over relocation details. You can reschedule via /calendar if needed.
